allocation.control_and_candidate: interleaved/blocked contemporaneously where server logistics permit
allocation.opponent_mix: same planned two-opponent stack distribution for B0 and B1
allocation.resource_limits: same decision-time and runtime policy for B0 and B1 except the bidding treatment itself
allocation.seats: balanced across forehand, middlehand, rearhand where server/table logistics permit

authorization_condition: Run only if clustered LOCAL_CONFIRMATION does not establish local regression.

opponent_policy.primary_stratum: unordered two-opponent stack plus SkatAI seat

pre_result_assertion: This protocol was created before inspecting any LOCAL_CONFIRMATION reward deltas or final decision.

primary_outcome.analysis: stratified bootstrap or equivalent cluster-aware interval over independent games/series; exact estimator and stopping thresholds must be frozen before first scored external game
primary_outcome.comparison: candidate minus control under matched opponent-stack/SkatAI-seat strata
primary_outcome.metric: per-game deployment scoring outcome recorded from ISS

purpose: Deployment-valid external gameplay gate after local non-regression only.
treatment: B1 learned bidding replaces B0 bidding; declaration, discard, cardplay and runtime constraints remain otherwise matched to frozen B0.
